notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
description:
Cast Venture Deeper from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {1} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill four cards and then exiling Venture Deeper.
Cast Merfolk Secretkeeper from exile by paying {1}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Merfolk Secretkeeper, adding {2}.
Repeat.
